en.headline: About 100 start-ups selected for Loop park mentorship
en.dek: The operator of the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park said chosen firms will be guided for five to eight years by tenants including AstraZeneca and Hithium.
body: About 100 start-ups have been chosen to enter the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park in the Lok Ma Chau Loop and will join mentorship programmes lasting five to eight years, the park operator said.

Vincent Ma, chief executive of Loop Hong Kong Park Company, told the South China Morning Post on Thursday that the firms were selected after several months of screening, and that some came from local universities. Mentorship will be provided by established companies already in the park, including the pharmaceutical firm AstraZeneca and the battery maker Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology.

The operator has also submitted a proposed list of sector-specific companies seeking access to a coming cross-border data-flow pilot. The park, on the Hong Kong side of the Hetao co-operation zone, is one of the innovation projects highlighted in the Chief Executive's latest Policy Address.

An earlier official briefing said the first-phase buildings had already drawn more than 60 tenants, with many focused on artificial intelligence, data science, life and health technology, microelectronics and new energy.

zh.headline: 河套創科園篩選約100間初創 將獲五年至八年導師計劃
zh.dek: 港深創新及科技園營運方表示，入園初創將由阿斯利康及海辰儲能等進駐企業提供導師支援。
body: 港深創新及科技園營運方表示，約100間初創企業已獲選進入落馬洲河套的園區，並會參與為期五年至八年的導師計劃。
園區營運公司Loop Hong Kong Park Company行政總裁Vincent Ma週四接受《南華早報》訪問時表示，有關初創經過數月篩選，部分來自本地大學。導師計劃將由園內已進駐的企業負責，包括製藥企業阿斯利康，以及電池製造商廈門海辰儲能科技。
營運方亦已提交一份擬議企業名單，供即將推行的跨境數據流通先導計劃參考。園區位於河套深港科技創新合作區香港園區，是行政長官最新一份施政報告提及的創科項目之一。
較早前官方簡報指，第一期樓宇已吸引超過60間企業進駐，當中不少聚焦人工智能、數據科學、生命健康科技、微電子及新能源。
